strategy.primary: Spellslinger amass: each noncreature spell amasses Orcs equal to its mana value. Cost reducers, delve, alternate and free costs don't lower mana value, so cheap high-MV spells (Blasphemous Act, Dig Through Time, Blood for the Blood God!, Volcanic Salvo, Treasure Cruise, free spells) grow a huge Orc Army.
strategy.secondary: Trigger multipliers (Harmonic Prodigy, Wizard's Staff, Veyran), Mauhúr and The Ozolith, and payoffs that turn the Army or its counters into damage (The Great Goblin, Soul's Fire, Chandra's Ignition, Widespread Brutality, Fall of Cair Andros).

commander_oracle_snapshots.name: Saruman, the White Hand
commander_oracle_snapshots.oracle_text:
Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, amass Orcs X, where X is that spell's mana value. (Put X +1/+1 counters on an Army you control. It's also an Orc. If you don't control an Army, create a 0/0 black Orc Army creature token first.)
Goblins and Orcs you control have ward {2}.

identity.why: Amass by mana value on every noncreature spell.
Fires the grown Army without sacrificing it.
An extra counter per placement event.
